_comment: Short window absolute-hot override. short usedPercent=90 >= SHORT_WIN_HOT_PERCENT (85) forces shortTint=hot regardless of pace; long deviation=0 → ok. bindingTint(hot, ok)=hot. Panel pace label = formatPace(longPace) = '+0%' — verifies the label stays from the long window even when binding tint comes from the short window.
